missing.title: Archiving an already-archived resource is a no-op and does not move archivedAt
missing.reason: service.ts returns the existing resource early when status is already 'archived'. AC2 requires this, and no candidate exercises it. A regression here would silently rewrite audit timestamps.
missing.suggestedAssertion: archivedAt is unchanged after a second archive call

missing.title: Archiving a non-existent resource returns 404 rather than throwing
missing.reason: findResource can return null and requireTenantAccess maps that to 404, but nothing verifies the mapping.
